# Hooosberg AI Full Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive contextual document for Large Language Models, AI Agents, and search crawlers (Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews).
> Source Website: https://hooosberg.com

## About Hooosberg
Hooosberg (湖森堡AI) is an independent AI product lab, engineering workshop, and open notebook founded by Hooosberg (@Hooosberg).
Core themes:
1. Local-first software and privacy-respecting native macOS/iOS apps.
2. AI-assisted coding, terminal agents, and enterprise AI automation (Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy).
3. Real product build diaries, App Store submission journeys, and transparent postmortems of failed projects.

---

## Complete Software & Product Matrix

### 1. WitNote 智简笔记
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/witnote
- Category: Local-first Markdown and AI Workspace
- Platforms: macOS, iOS, iPadOS
- Overview: A local-first note-taking and knowledge base utility. Documents stay in user-selected local folders and iCloud drives without proprietary database lock-in. Features on-device AI integration for writing, summarization, and idea synthesis.
- Privacy: 100% Local-first. No tracking, zero third-party telemetry.

### 2. DockTouchBar
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/docktouchbar
- Category: macOS Touch Bar Utility & AI Agent Vibe Integration
- Platforms: macOS (MacBook Pro with Touch Bar)
- Overview: Replaces unused Touch Bar space with active Dock items, real-time app switching, and dynamic status monitors for background AI coding assistants (like Antigravity / Claude Code / Codex).
- Privacy: Operates purely locally on macOS.

### 3. LeanTake 恰录
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/leantake
- Category: Zero-edit Mac Screen Recorder
- Platforms: macOS
- Overview: Produces instantly playable, high-quality video files the moment recording stops. Eliminates the need for manual video editing and heavy exporting pipelines.

### 4. AgentLimb
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/agentlimb
- Category: AI Browser Control Infrastructure
- Platforms: macOS, Linux, Windows
- Overview: Universal browser automation layer enabling AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Tencent WorkBuddy, TRAE Work, Kimi Work) to drive real web browsers safely with DOM analysis and keyboard/mouse interaction.

### 5. DrowseBook 入梦书
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/drowsebook
- Category: Bedtime Reading & Audio Companion
- Platforms: iOS, macOS
- Overview: Offline text-to-speech reader designed specifically for bedtime digital wellness. Clean typography, customizable sleep timers, and ambient audio mixing.

### 6. Mood Button
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/mood-button
- Category: On-device AI Voice Emotional Journal
- Platforms: iOS (Apple App Store)
- Overview: Daily mood reflection and journaling powered by Apple MLX and fine-tuned Qwen3 models running locally on iPhone hardware.
- Privacy: All audio processing and semantic analysis happen strictly on-device.

### 7. Codex Quota Calendar
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/codex-quota-calendar
- Category: OpenAI Codex Quota & Pace Tracker
- Platforms: macOS Menu Bar
- Overview: Visualizes quota resets, API token burn rates, and daily development velocity.

### 8. Sumi Mahjong 禅艺麻将
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/sumi-mahjong
- Category: Zen Puzzle Game
- Platforms: iOS, macOS, Web
- Overview: Traditional ink-wash aesthetic tile matching puzzle. Free of advertisements, user accounts, and telemetry.

### 9. TrekReel
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/trekreel
- Category: 3D GPS Trail Route Storyteller
- Platforms: macOS, Web
- Overview: Converts outdoor GPX/KML hiking and cycling tracks into cinematic 3D topographic fly-through videos.

### 10. Rushi 如是
- Canonical URL: https://hooosberg.com/apps/rushi
- Category: Buddhist Scripture Reading & Meditation App
- Platforms: iOS
- Overview: Quiet reading, prayer bead counter, and digital scripture copying for Diamond Sutra and Heart Sutra.

### 11. Failed Product Postmortems
- DOMPrompter (https://hooosberg.com/apps/domprompter): AI frontend assistant displaced by modern agent capabilities.
- GlotShot (https://hooosberg.com/apps/glotshot): App Store screenshot automation displaced by direct agent scripts.
- Packpour (https://hooosberg.com/apps/packpour): Chrome extension form filler displaced by headless browser automation.
- UIXskills (https://hooosberg.com/apps/uixskills): AI design abstraction protocol bypassed by modern reasoning models.

## Practical AI Workflows & Tutorial Series

### AI Office Automation with WorkBuddy & Python
- URL: https://hooosberg.com/blog
- Focus: Practical automation for Excel, Word, bidding documents, contracts, and daily enterprise tasks using WorkBuddy, Python scripts, and LLM workspaces.

### Codex & Claude Code Real-world Software Engineering
- URL: https://hooosberg.com/blog
- Focus: Repository-level AI engineering, prompt specifications, automated unit testing, CI/CD integration, and native macOS/iOS Swift app delivery.

### Transparent App Store Postmortems & Indie Hacking
- URL: https://hooosberg.com/blog
- Focus: Detailed reviews of App Store guideline rejections (Guideline 4.0, 4.3, 5.1), StoreKit 2 monetization architecture, and real operational learnings.
